reviews.review.publish.description: Put a review on the public site. Until this it is visible only in the console. Needs a review in context.

reviews.review.reject.description: Keep a review off the site. It stays readable in the console. Needs a review in context.

reviews.review.reply.description: Write the shop's answer, which is shown together with the review. Needs a review in context.

reviews.review.create.description: Enter a review the shop received elsewhere — by phone, in person, or copied from a platform. It arrives on moderation like any other.

reviews.invite.create.brief: Ask a customer for a review
reviews.invite.create.description: Mint a personal one-shot review link for one order and one address. The outreach workflow sends it on its next run.
